corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns artillery damage. Flying artillery is never credited as blocked. Its death before civilian lethal damage and route exit is mandatory.
Midnight clears upper eastern then western roadblocks. Civilians remain neutral and are neither attacked nor blocked by operators.
Kroos clears the lower eastern roadblock after artillery clearance; Steward later clears the western roadblock. Spot intercepts pursuing officers.
Fang blocks upper central; Kroos supplies initial damage, Ansel heals, and returning Steward clears armor.
Friston blocks lower central; Fang and Kroos shorten exposure. Ansel sustains the lane; returning Steward must kill remaining armor including #34.
Midnight owns upper outer through its last hostile clearance, with temporary extended Ansel coverage.
Spot owns lower outer, alternating damage with self-healing. Healing-mode damage is zero; retained enemies must remain within three-block capacity.

formation_structure.artillery_geometry: At frames 2321 and 2411, Ansel is [5,5] and Steward is [2,6], separated by sqrt(10) tiles. This removes their previous adjacent placement. Exact splash radius is not supplied, so disjoint splash coverage is a verification requirement, not an established fact. Kroos remains adjacent to Steward and is a residual shared-splash risk.
formation_structure.artillery_output: Steward UP from [2,6] covers eastern patrol cells around [2,7], [3,7] and [4,7], but not the lower [5,7] wait. Approximately 75 seconds of exclusive equivalent contact are needed using the conservative 470-ATK estimate. Actual contact, competition and survival must establish the kill; deployment duration cannot substitute for damage.

economy.conditional_dependency: Missing Fang income is a survival or skill-execution failure. No future grant, death refund or undeployed skill is credited.

first_four_deployments.source: Initial DP, including supported self-cost reduction.
Natural income plus Fang's first observed 6-DP grant.

economy.redeployment_basis: Supplied prior inspected current-model unchanged fees: Steward 18, Kroos 11, Midnight 16; each scheduled redeployment exceeds 70 seconds off field. Natural income independently funds rotations. Refunds require successful living retreats.

remaining_opening.source: 17 natural DP after Midnight; no second grant needed.
11 natural DP plus Fang's second observed 6-DP grant.
17 natural DP plus Fang's third observed 6-DP grant.

formation_structure.execution_semantics: Fixed actions only. Handoff requirements are assertions, not executable branches. Failure of an assertion invalidates dependent actions; it does not create a substitute deployment.
formation_structure.medical_geometry: Ansel [5,5] DOWN covers Fang [3,5], Friston [4,5], Kroos [2,5] and Steward [2,6]. His extension reaches Midnight [1,5]. Spot [6,5] heals himself and Ansel during skill. Ansel does not ordinarily heal Spot.
formation_structure.mortality_policy: No required death. An operator death may have contributed damage or blocking, but yields no refund and releases blocked enemies. No death-dependent redeploy is scheduled. An unexpected central death has no guaranteed substitute and invalidates the containment hypothesis.
formation_structure.validation_status: UNSIMULATED; no shell commands, file mutations, simulations or other AI providers used.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Exactly these seven distinct catalog IDs; every identity rarity is 1-3 and normal_mode is true. No reserve units or hidden substitutes.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col] and an explicit direction; never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Friston survives beyond 982 and until effective medical support; Fang remains alive for credited opening income. Early output is a proposed causal repair, not a verified survival result.
Ansel [5,5] and Steward [2,6] at 2321/2411; verify actual splash separation and each unit's HP. Spot skill must be active during that window.
Retreat only has its planned justification if its required kill/clearance assertion holds. Released enemies, projectiles and vacant-lane capacity must all be accounted for.
Zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe arrivals. Neither ordinary operator targeting nor healing is assumed to manipulate civilians.
Artillery must die before it causes any protected-target death and before its exit. Historical civilian deaths at 3945 and 5341 are warning checkpoints, not guaranteed timings under this formation.
No retreat from central damage duty before #34 and every remaining hostile are dead.
remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and two safe arrivals. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Kroos must reduce central trooper exposure enough for Friston to survive frame 982 and reach Ansel deployment. Fang must survive and produce the first two grants. Midnight and Spot must intercept their first outer troopers before passage.

Ansel recovers central operators. Spot's 1952 activation keeps adjacent medical reinforcement active at 2321/2411. Steward occupies [2,6], not [5,6]. No old projectile lock time is assumed to recur exactly.

Maintain four interceptions while Steward accumulates actual artillery contact. Protected survival must be observed throughout; a living civilian at phase end is insufficient if either earlier died. Adjacent Kroos/Steward splash and healer target selection remain material risks.

Fang and Friston retain unresolved central enemies without Kroos or Steward. No remaining artillery or projectile may threaten the rotation. Block capacity and survival during this 70-second gap are explicit feasibility obligations.
Steward clears central armor before leaving; Kroos and Midnight clear eastern lower and western upper restraints. Spot continues lower interception.
Destroy the western lower roadblock and observe both safe arrivals. Extend observation beyond this illustrative horizon if necessary; never infer acceptance from elapsed time.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic DP only while deployed and alive. Opening budgets require grants near 19, 44 and 69 seconds; do not issue manual actions.
Automatic enhanced attacks; no probabilistic talent credited.
Upper-outer and eastern restraint arts windows; subsequent activations allow more than 40 active plus 70 inactive seconds.
Delayed first healing window covers historical medical collapse; later windows obey 25 active plus 40 inactive seconds. No dodge or simultaneous attacks credited.

Boost central healing and extend toward Midnight while he remains deployed. First use follows more than 25 seconds of charging; later uses follow 25 active plus 35 inactive seconds. No extra-heal talent credited.
Automatic enhanced arts hits and supported defense priority; roadblocks and other targets can reduce artillery contact.

tactical_thesis: Restore early Kroos damage before medical expenditure, retain four ground interceptions, separate Steward from Ansel, and reserve Spot healing for the exposed medical window. After artillery clearance, rotate ranged output through armor and roadblock duties. This is a complete, unsimulated CURRENT_MODEL_CHECKABLE hypothesis; protected-target survival until artillery clearance remains its principal unresolved risk.
